title: Improve answers
intro: Review unanswered questions and replies customers rated poorly, then add an approved answer to your workspace knowledge.
definitions: Unanswered means no knowledge source was found or the model requested human help. Feedback comes from widget votes, with one current vote per reply. Satisfaction is the percentage of positive votes; no votes shows a dash. Metrics include resolved and dismissed replies.
coverage: Tracks live AI replies recorded after this feature is deployed. Previews, human notices and older conversations are excluded. Date filters use UTC; reply times below use IST.
error: Could not load answer reviews. Try again.
topHelp: Questions with the same text, ignoring case and extra spaces, are counted together.
noTop: No questions recorded in this period.
draftHelp: Review the question and write an approved answer. Saving publishes it to curated Q&A for future replies; it does not send a message to the customer.
question: Q&A question
analyticsLink: Review top questions, feedback and unanswered replies
